ad_info.structure_source: library format F03 (Antes / Después), following the layout of the winning reference ad (same format family)
ad_info.reference_style: Photorealistic before/after split-screen supplement ad with color header blocks, the product as hero on the split line, benefit cards and an offer bar
ad_info.angle_used: Transformación / resultado: from jeans that sit loose at the back to jeans that finally fit

global_identity.color_palette: Brand: hot fuchsia #E6177F, deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226, bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 accent text, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF. Secondary for this variation: warm sunset gold #F2B66D and sand #E8D3B0 in the 'after' scene light.
global_identity.visual_style: Photorealistic, bold and feminine supplement ad: real-looking Colombian woman, real scenes, the real bottle sharp and identical to the photo, fuchsia and plum brand blocks.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Cold, flat fitting-room light on the left; warm golden sunset on the right; glossy fuchsia glow on the bottom cards.
global_identity.graphic_language: Solid flat header blocks, hard vertical split line, rounded cards with thin glowing fuchsia borders and white thin-line icons, rounded pill offer bar with a vertical divider.
global_identity.text_typography: ANTES / DESPUÉS in a very heavy geometric sans-serif (Montserrat Black look), uppercase, white; subtitles in rounded bold sans-serif (Poppins SemiBold look), sentence case, white; card and offer texts in heavy uppercase sans-serif.

creative_objective: Keep the essence of the winning ad (see in one second the change, with the bottle as the cause) while changing context and facet: the same woman seen from behind, first in a store fitting room where her light jeans sit loose at the back, then on another day at a sunset outdoor mall terrace wearing dark high-rise jeans that fit her well. The bottle bridges both states.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The before/after contrast of the same woman from behind. 2) ANTES / DESPUÉS headers with their subtitles. 3) The bottle in the center on the split line. 4) The four benefit cards. 5) The offer bar.
art_direction.composition_style: Same structure as the winning reference: two header blocks on top (left dark plum, right fuchsia), two photo panels below split exactly at 50% width, the bottle large in the center straddling the split line, a row of four cards and a full-width pill offer bar at the bottom.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Header blocks: top 0-12% of the height, each 50% wide. Photo panels: 12-68% of the height. Bottle: centered horizontally, from about 22% to 68% of the height, about 24% of the canvas width, bottom edge overlapping the top of the card row. Cards: 69-87% of the height, four equal cards with 2% gaps and 2% side margins. Offer bar: 89-98% of the height, 4% side margins.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Left panel: flat cool fluorescent light, slightly desaturated. Right panel: warm golden-hour backlight with sunset glow. Bottle: crisp studio highlights and soft shadow, in sharp focus. Bottom area: dark plum-to-magenta gradient with soft fuchsia glow around cards.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square canvas. Top row: two solid header blocks side by side; left dark plum with 'ANTES' and a two-line subtitle, right hot fuchsia with 'DESPUÉS' and a two-line subtitle. Middle: two photo panels split vertically at 50% showing the same woman from behind in the same pose; left in a fitting room with loose light jeans, right on a sunset terrace with fitted dark jeans. The real bottle stands large in the center over the split line. Below: a row of four rounded cards with thin glowing fuchsia borders, each with a white line icon and a short uppercase benefit. Bottom: a full-width rounded pill offer bar with 'TRATAMIENTO COMPLETO' and 'X3 FRASCOS' on the left, a thin vertical divider, and a pale pink pill on the right reading 'PAGAS AL RECIBIR'.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 photorealistic before/after supplement ad. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it, and do not copy the bottle or brand shown in the style reference. The product is a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, with a glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap printed with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' wordmark pattern, and a solid hot-pink band wrapping the bottom fifth of the bottle. The black label shows, from top to bottom: a small pink VITALABH emblem with the white word 'VITALABH'; a huge bold white condensed word 'AGUAJE'; the line 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with 'COMPLEX' in white and '3 EN 1' in pink-red; a thin hot-pink banner reading 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS'; a small white line 'A base de Aguaje, Fenogreco y Maca Negra'; a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a pink swoosh underline; three small black rounded boxes outlined in pink joined by white plus signs reading '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO' and '200mg MACA NEGRA'; and at the bottom '60 CÁPSULAS | (0.5 g c/u Cont. Neto 30g)' in small white type. LAYOUT: top 12% of the canvas is two solid header blocks side by side: the left half dark plum #2B1226 with the giant white word 'ANTES' and a two-line white subtitle below it; the right half hot fuchsia #E6177F with the giant white word 'DESPUÉS' and a two-line white subtitle. Below, from 12% to 68% of the height, two photo panels split exactly at 50% width by a hard vertical line. LEFT PANEL (before): a Colombian woman about 26 years old, light-brown skin, black wavy hair in a low bun, slim natural body, seen from behind from shoulders to knees, standing straight inside a store fitting room with a grey curtain, under cold flat fluorescent light, slightly desaturated; she wears light-blue mid-rise jeans that are visibly loose and baggy at the back and a loose grey t-shirt. No product in this half. RIGHT PANEL (after): the SAME woman, same back view, same framing and same scale, on another day, hair now loose and wavy, on an open-air mall terrace in Cali at golden hour with warm sunset light in gold #F2B66D and sand #E8D3B0 tones; she wears dark-blue high-rise jeans that fit her well at the back and a short fuchsia top; her figure looks naturally a little fuller and more shaped, a believable and natural difference, not exaggerated. The bottle stands large in the exact center of the canvas, straddling the split line, from about 22% to 68% of the height, front view, sharp, label readable, with a soft shadow, its base slightly overlapping the top of the card row. BOTTOM AREA (68-100%): dark plum to deep magenta #B0105E gradient background with a soft fuchsia glow. A row of four equal rounded cards (69-87% of the height) with thin glowing fuchsia borders, each with a simple white thin-line icon on top and a short uppercase white label below: card 1 a shield icon, card 2 two capsules icon, card 3 three joined leaves icon, card 4 a small drop icon. Under them a full-width rounded pill offer bar (89-98% of the height) in deep magenta with a thin fuchsia glowing border: on the left two lines of heavy uppercase text, the second larger in bubblegum pink #FF8CC0 with small accent rays on both sides; a thin vertical divider; on the right a pale blush pink #FBE3EE pill with extra-heavy deep magenta text. All texts exactly as listed, readable on a phone. Do not add prices, seals, stars, badges, CTA buttons or any extra text.

mandatory_visual_elements: Two solid header blocks on top: dark plum on the left, hot fuchsia on the right
Vertical 50/50 split of the same woman seen from behind with the same pose and framing
Before half cold and muted in a fitting room, without the product
After half warm golden sunset on an outdoor terrace

final_generation_exclusions: No price, no currency signs, no discounts.
No health registration, INVIMA, quality or certification seals.
No rating stars, reviews, testimonials or result timeframes.
No bikini or swimwear; no exaggerated or sexualized body.
Do not copy the bottle, logo or brand of the style reference.
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts. The before/after is natural (same woman, different day, clothes and light) and speaks about the fit of the jeans, not about defects.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish (Colombia).
